extraction.Name: Samuel Miller (deceased); Mary Haukaas Miller (deponent, wife/widow)
extraction.Refused/Protested: You do not know whether he protested the patent? No.
extraction.Occupation/Income: I am making garden (Mary Haukaas Miller)
extraction.NOTES: Samuel Miller died April 21, 1929. Mary Haukaas Miller is his widow and deponent. Samuel Miller had eight living children. He deeded the land to Mary at one time, she deeded it back to him, and he then sold it to John Gormley of Herrick for a mortgage of $4500.00 plus additional consideration totaling $21,000.00 in all. Samuel also had a house in Herrick which he sold. Money was used to buy another place and 'spent a lot of it foolishly.' Mary states she has not been in good health. Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Crose, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 1, 1929.
